questions.stem: A circle has an area of $49\pi\text{ cm}^2$. What is its radius?
What is the area of a semicircle with diameter $12\text{ cm}$? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: Radius $= 6\text{ cm}$. Full circle area $= \pi \times 6^2 = 36\pi\text{ cm}^2$. Semicircle area $= \frac{36\pi}{2} = 18\pi\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.stem: A circular pond has a radius of $4\text{ m}$. A path $1\text{ m}$ wide surrounds the pond. What is the area of the path in terms of $\pi$?
questions.explanation: Outer circle radius $= 4 + 1 = 5\text{ m}$. Path area $= \pi(5^2) - \pi(4^2) = 25\pi - 16\pi = 9\pi\text{ m}^2$.
